newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Merchants 96 net falls 21 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Merchants 96 net falls 21 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.31 yuan vs 0.45 yuan
Net assets per share 2.96 yuan vs 2.35 yuan
Company name: China Merchants Shekou Port Service Co Ltd.
Note: The results were published in the firm's 1996 annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Wednesday.
The net profit figures are based on international accounting standards and other figures on Chinese accounting standards.
Under domestic accounting standards, the company posted net profits of 100.16 million yuan for 1996 against 125.56 million yuan for 1995.
The firm's board of directors proposed no returns for 1996, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on May 30, the annual report said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares was suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has said.
